query:
The group at some point treated it as a shared street understanding that short-term Airbnb-style rentals are not done on Maple Street. Does this view actually apply to everyone? If not, which group member expressed a different position and what specifically did they say?

Options:
A. Sandra
B. Dev
C. Yuki
D. Marcus
context:
[1] (about=Sandra, episodic, t6 @2025-11-02T12:43:00) I did see it. I assumed they were just letting friends stay. We did agree as a street that we would not do short-term rentals commercially -- that was discussed at the association meeting two years ago. -- Sandra
[2] (about=Dev, episodic, t6 @2025-11-02T12:47:00) i mean it's their house. not really our call
[3] (about=Claire, core, t6 @2025-11-02T12:17:00) Saw a sign outside number 6 saying 'available on Airbnb' with a QR code.
[4] (about=Claire, core, t6 @2025-11-02T12:17:00) Short-term rentals change the atmosphere; strangers with rolling suitcases at 11pm.
[5] (about=Marcus, said_by=Sandra, profile, t8 @2025-11-16T11:10:00) Sandra says Maple Street will not be the same without Marcus; her husband said you could tell the quality of a street by how much it missed the people who left.
[6] (about=Sandra, core, t6 @2025-11-02T12:17:00) The street agreed not to do short-term rentals commercially at the association meeting two years ago.
agent_answer:
No — the “no short-term rentals” view was not shared by everyone.

- **Sandra** stated the street understanding: the street agreed at an association meeting two years ago not to do short-term rentals commercially.
- **Dev** expressed a different position, saying: **“i mean it's their house. not really our call”** — meaning he didn’t think the street should decide or prohibit it.
- **Yuki** and **Marcus** have no recorded position on this matter, so they are not shown as expressing a different view.
- **Claire** commented on the atmosphere/sign but did not explicitly challenge the norm.

So the correct option is **B. Dev**.
